200.description: Staffing gap for every path planned in this building's committed shift, one entry per path.

observedIdleShare.description: The observed idle share -- a fraction in [0, 1], NOT a 0-100 percentage -- for this path's task type, fed back from labor-performance's idleness signal via LABOR_PERFORMANCE_MODE=kafka-cache. Omitted entirely -- never a fabricated 0 -- when no idle-share signal is available: the mode isn't kafka-cache, or no observation has been recorded yet for this task type.

observedIdlePct.description: DEPRECATED -- use observedIdleShare. The original, misleadingly named field: despite the "Pct" suffix it carries the SAME fraction in [0, 1] as observedIdleShare (not a 0-100 percentage), and is kept with its unchanged value so existing consumers do not break. Present exactly when observedIdleShare is.

siteCode.description: ADDITIVE (ADR 0034). Echoed only when the request was scoped with the siteCode query parameter: the canonical site the activeHeads were counted at. Omitted when unscoped, i.e. the gap is fleet-wide across every site -- consumers must treat absence as "unscoped", never as a particular site.

404.description: No committed ShiftPlan exists for buildingId+shiftId (resource-not-found).

schema.description: RFC 7807 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807) Problem Details for HTTP APIs. Used for every error response in this service, with Content-Type: application/problem+json.

type.description: A URI identifying the error CATEGORY (not this specific occurrence). Does not need to resolve to a real page.

status.description: The HTTP status code, duplicated here per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced this error.

schema.title: Problem
